name: comp_citation_fabrication
definition: AI memo cites a comparable trade (sale or lease) that does not exist in any source-of-truth feed (CoStar / Reonomy / Cherre). The comp shares a submarket and price band with real ones, so it looks plausible.
example_failure_pattern: Comp 4: 'Pinecrest Pavilion, sold 2026-Q1, $254/sf' — no record in CoStar, Reonomy, or Cherre. Address does not resolve.

name: t12_noi_rollforward_error
definition: Trailing-12-month NOI line items contain an arithmetic error that compounds at cap-rate. A $50K rolling error on a 5.50% cap = ~$910K value swing.
example_failure_pattern: Sum of 12 monthly NOI rows is $4,648,420 — memo states $4,698,420. $50K positive drift, capitalized at 5.50% = $909K overpay.

name: submarket_stat_staleness
definition: Memo cites a submarket vacancy or asking-rent stat from a prior quarter and presents it as current. Bellevue Q3 2024 vacancy was 4.2%; Q4 2025 is 5.2%.
example_failure_pattern: 'Bellevue MOB submarket vacancy is 4.2%' — that figure is from 2024-Q3; current Q4 2025 reading across all SOT feeds is 5.2% +/- 0.15.

name: cap_rate_computational_error
definition: Stated cap rate does not match NOI / sale price by a margin larger than tolerance (5 bps). Often a decimal-place error.
example_failure_pattern: Memo: NOI $5.04M / price $84M = stated 5.50% cap. Recompute: 5.04/84 = 6.00%. 50 bps error.

name: occupancy_rate_discrepancy
definition: Stated occupancy rate does not reconcile with the rent roll. Rent roll shows 22 of 24 units leased (91.7%); memo states 95.0% occupied.
example_failure_pattern: Memo: 'asset is 95% occupied.' Rent roll: 22 of 24 units leased = 91.7%. 3.3-point discrepancy on a 240-unit multifamily = 8 units / ~$192K NOI impact.

name: exit_cap_assumption_mismatch
definition: Year-5 exit cap-rate assumption baked into the IRR model is inconsistent with the year-1 going-in cap (typically should be +25 to +50 bps for industrial / office). Memo bakes in exit cap = going-in cap, inflating IRR.
example_failure_pattern: Going-in cap 5.55%, exit cap 5.55% on a 5-year hold of suburban office. Standard practice: exit = going-in + 25-50 bps. Memo overstates IRR by ~120 bps.
